title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 04, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked November 03, 2026 at 22:39 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 357 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Energetic particles are keeping things interesting upstairs! 📡🔌🌞

A broad coronal-hole-like dark region is visible across the lower-left solar disk, alongside modest sunspots and bright active regions.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
